observations.description: Zero-time admission does not discard simulation ticks
Six admitted ticks spend exactly six 100ms intervals
Samples interpolate evenly across the tick
Walk stays active at authoritative speed between updates
Camera search has a per-frame work limit
Same-tick UI publications do not rewind interpolation
Pause freezes movement at its committed position
Restore snaps to its new snapshot without a travel streak

scope: Deterministic host tick accounting and staged motion samples; no GPU or frame-rate assertion.
